en-US.name: VIP Monthly
en-US.description: Every pack and every past month, no breaks

reviewNote: Auto-renewable monthly subscription with a 7-day free trial. VIP unlocks every pack (including past monthly daily packs) and hides the game's own store promotions. The grant is applied server-side by our Appwrite Function after verifying the signed transaction; during review the function runs against the Sandbox environment. Test: Home > tap coin balance > Store > Go VIP > Monthly, confirm with a Sandbox Apple ID. A VIP badge appears on Home and in Profile within a few seconds.
